notes: Figures transcribed from the 2026 Nutrition and Allergen Guide PDF (May 2026 upload, labelled "April 2025" inside) linked from https://rubios.com/nutrition-allergen/. The guide lists whole items plus "Add" proteins, sides, dressings and sauces; it does not publish tortillas, cheese, pico, cabbage, bacon or crema portions inside items, so those are not components.

Bowl and salad rows in the guide are 1 serving without protein (the menu calorie ranges equal base + Add protein). Items named "... with <protein>" sum the published base and the published Add protein.
Burrito bases are published burritos minus their published Add protein; see each component's "derived".

Sour Cream (90 kcal, 7 g fat, 1 g carb, 1 g protein) and the Gluten-free Honduran Chocolate Brownie (350 kcal, 18/61/4) are omitted because their published calories differ from their macros by more than 20%.
Langostino Lobster items carry their own "source": they appear only in the February 2026 guide.

grilled chicken.note: Add Grilled All Natural Chicken, 3.9 oz

grilled steak.note: Add All Natural Steak, 3.9 oz. Guide lists total fat 3.5 g but 80 calories from fat and 200 kcal; fat taken as 80/9 = 9 g (consistent with steak-vs-chicken burrito differences). Listed fiber 1 g set to 0 because carbs are 0.

beer-battered fish.note: Add Battered Fish, 2 pieces / 3.6 oz (wild Alaska pollock)

grilled mahi mahi.note: Add Grilled Wild Mahi Mahi, 2 pieces / 3 oz

blackened mahi mahi.note: Add Blackened Wild Mahi Mahi, 2 pieces / 3 oz

black beans.note: Black Beans, regular (6.1 oz), topped with melted cheese

pinto beans.note: "No-Fried" Pinto Beans, regular (6.1 oz), topped with melted cheese

avocado crema.note: Guide lists total fat 0 g but 80 calories from fat and 90 kcal; fat taken as 80/9 = 9 g.

especial burrito base.note: Flour tortilla, citrus rice, black beans, guac, pico, roasted chipotle salsa, chipotle crema

coastal catch burrito base.note: Flour tortilla, Mexican rice, guac, corn, cabbage, cilantro/onion, chipotle crema

quesa bacon burrito base.derived: Shrimp & Bacon Burrito minus Add Pan-Seared Shrimp
quesa bacon burrito base.note: Flour tortilla, citrus rice, toasted cheese, bacon, guac, pico, blackened jalapenos, chipotle salsa, chipotle crema

omega-3 bowl base.derived: Omega-3 Bowl with Grilled Salmon minus Add Grilled Salmon

california bowl base.note: California Bowl, 1 serving, no protein: citrus rice, black beans, guac, cabbage, pico, avocado tomatillo vinaigrette, chipotle crema

mexican street corn bowl base.note: Mexican Street Corn Bowl, 1 serving, no protein

double protein bowl base.note: Double Protein Bowl (Base): Mexican rice, black beans, avocado, pickled onions, pico, spicy arbol sauce, lime crema

chopped salad base.note: Chopped Salad, 1 serving, no protein: romaine/cabbage blend, cheese, corn chips, pico, chipotle ranch

baja caesar salad base.note: Baja Caesar Salad, 1 serving, no protein
